$Comment: Rip Cut, a Crafting technique (the Mill Technique choice on the Crafting tree): the jar's Mill with two logs to a cycle. Parent Mill gives it every group it does not author, per leaf, so the bench, its custody, its tool gate, its bonus tables and its look all stay the jar's; what changes is here. Each cycle first takes one more log from the placed pile (Consume, any material, from Custody), then runs the recipe, whose Yield.Base 2 makes two planks of the log it converts, and the hatchet wears 2 a cycle instead of 1: a cycle saws twice the logs for twice the planks and twice the wear, at the same pace. Every roll on the cycle (the tool ladder, the finds, the talents) still rolls once. Extensions/SawmillTechniques.json adds it to the Sawmill ahead of Mill, gated on the Rip Cut talent, and Extensions/SawmillProgression_Rip_Cut.json gives it the same XP and tables Mill gets.

Steps.$Comment: The extra log. Should the pile hold only one, this step takes it and the recipe beat finds nothing to convert, so the engine gives that log back when the session stops.
The recipe: one log in, two planks out.
